summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 30, 2026, reporting routine share issuances upon RSU settlements and option exercises by employees and one director. The company issued 765,024 Class A ordinary shares to non-director participants at $0.20 per share and 5,521 Class A shares to a director at no cost, raising the Class A total to 354,095,390 and overall issued shares to 434,413,615. No takeover, buyback, or special-situation event is disclosed.
